This story remediates a confirmed AppSec finding from tracker #2904 with fail-closed tests and CHANGELOG citation. Parent umbrella remains open until all batch children merge.
narratives.Overview:
## Parent
Part of AppSec scan tracker **#2904** (2026-07-29). Remediation **Batch C** (deposit write integrity).

## Finding
| | |
| --- | --- |
| **ID** | `install-deposit-06` |
| **Severity** | **Medium** |
| **Dimension** | `install-deposit` |
| **Surface** | npm `directive update` / deposit refresh |

## Issue
npm `directive update` is **additive copy**. Stale or malicious files under `.deft/core` can **survive** upgrade. Go install path does full swap — inconsistent integrity.

## Remediation
1. Full tree replace or delete-not-in-source on npm refresh.
2. Refuse VERSION stamp until reconcile succeeds.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Update leaves no dst-only agent content under `.deft/core` after refresh
- [ ] Parity with Go full-swap integrity model (or documented intentional residual)
- [ ] Tests / CHANGELOG

## Refs
- Tracker #2904
- Batch C siblings: install-deposit-04, skill-pack-supply-01
narratives.UserStory: As a security engineer, I want npm directive update to fully replace .deft/core so stale agent content cannot survive, so that content VERSION stamps match a reconciled deposit without dst-only leftovers.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.ts, replace additive copyTree merge with full tree replace (stage + atomic swap or delete-not-in-source reconcile like Go swapInCore / prunePackageAbsentDepositPaths expanded beyond packages). Refuse VERSION stamp until reconcile succeeds. Tests for dst-only file removal. CHANGELOG cites #2913. Note any existing prunePackageAbsentDepositPaths work and complete the gap.
